brief: Goldman Sachs Prime Services estimates hedge fund performance at the Nov 5 2026 US close during a broader market sell-off, broken out by strategy with no stated thesis beyond the data. Global Fundamental long/short managers fell 1.3% (a -2 SD move), driven mainly by market/beta exposure, leaving them up 8.7% YTD. TMT funds were hit hardest, down more than 4% and now roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, versus about +24% YTD before the June/July AI sell-off. US-focused funds fell 1.7%, now up 5.5% YTD. Systematic long/short managers were the exception, up 0.2% as gains in the US and EM Asia offset losses in Europe and DM Asia, leaving them up 16% YTD. Multi-Strategy managers fell 1.4%, driven by a sell-off in high-beta names, Information Technology and Momentum (down 3.7 SD), plus negative idiosyncratic returns. The note reports these estimates without arguing a forward view.
